text:
Xbox studio leaders reportedly think Game Pass “devalues” their games Recent comments from Xbox leadership suggest the developers are unhappy with XBOX Game Pass, exposing a problem Microsoft can no longer solve with subscriber numbers or carefully worded corporate statements. According to the Bloomberg’s Jason Schreier, some XBOX studio leaders believe the subscription service has damaged the value of their games and weakened the wider market. […]
